newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France ups Paris-S'pore cargo flights.
newsitem.headline: Air France ups Paris-S'pore cargo flights.

text.p: Air France Cargo said it planned to increase weekly frequencies Boeing 747-200F freighter on its Paris-Singapore service from three to four due to strong demand.
The fourth weekly frequency will be launched with the introduction of winter schedules at end-October, an Air France cargo official said.
"We began carrying freight between Paris and Singapore on combis several years ago and this has now developed into a major full-freighter route for us."
Each of the three existing freighter flights on the route is operated in conjunction with Singapore Airlines.

It had not yet been decided whether the new frequency will be operated independently by Air France or in partnership with SIA, the official added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
